note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, one for each of the eight electoral divisions. The nominations were received on 6 May 1936 and, as there was no contest, the nominees were returned unopposed. Polling in County Down was fixed for 28 May 1936. Filed on 1936-06-04, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Down that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1936-05-28 (verification 5 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
